Excellent stay near Karol Bagh Metro Station!
Had a wonderful experience at this hotel. The location is very convenient, just a short walk from Karol Bagh Metro Station, making travel around Delhi very easy. The staff was extremely polite, helpful, and professional, which made our stay comfortable and pleasant. The rooms were clean and well-maintained. Overall, it’s a great hotel with excellent service. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Delhi.
